'''﻿a'''
: 'and/or'
:(conjunction for nouns)
:class: A

:Related words: '''ja''', '''a''', '''e''', '''ji''', '''o''', '''u'''

:'''ei mi tavla la alis a la kevin''' = ''I need to speak to Alice or Kevin (or to both of them).''
'''a'a'''
:'''a'a''' - attention, '''a'acu'i''' - inattentiveness, '''a'anai''' - avoiding
:(interjection)
:class: UI1

:Related words: See also '''jundi''', '''rivbi'''

:'''.a'a ko ca'o skicu''' = ''I'm listening, go on talking!''
:'''.a'a cu'i ko denpa lo nu mi jai gau mulno ti''' = ''Eh, just a second, let me finish this.''
:'''a'a nai mi na tirna''' = ''La, la, la, I'm not listening.''
'''a'e'''
:'''a'e''' - alertness, '''a'enai''' - exhaustion
:(interjection)
:class: UI1

:Related words: See also '''sanji''', '''cikna''', '''tatpi'''

:'''.a'e ba vlile tcima .a'e nai mi klama lo ckana''' = ''It's going to be a storm. Yaaaawn, I'm going to bed.''
'''a'ei'''
:'''a'ei''' - 'Come on!' (call, instigation, invocation)
:(interjection)
:class: UI1

:'''a'ei klama lo zdani''' = ''Let's go home.''
:'''do a'ei co'u denpa''' = ''C'mon, what are you waiting for?''
'''a'i'''
:'''a'i''' - 'Oomph!' (effort, endeavor), '''a'icu'i''' - 'no special effort', '''a'inai''' - 'repose'
:(interjection)
:class: UI1

:Related words: See also '''gunka''', '''slunandu''', '''guksurla''', '''troci''', '''selprogunka'''

:'''a'i mi ca'o ralte''' = ''I'm trying to hold it!''
:'''a'i cu'i ti frili''' = ''Ah, this is easy.''
:'''a'i nai cikre ta''' = ''Nah, why bother fixing it.''
'''a'o'''
:'''a'o''' - hope, '''a'onai''' - 'Gah!' (despair)
:(interjection)
:class: UI1

:Related words: See also '''pacna'''

:'''a'o vamji fa lo nu zukte''' = ''I hope, it's worth doing it.''
:'''a'onai mi co'u ponse da''' = ''Gah, I lost all my property.''
'''a'u'''
:'''a'u''' - 'Hmm... I wonder ...' (interest), '''a'ucu'i''' - 'Ho-hum' (disinterest), '''a'unai''' - 'Eww! Yuck!' (repulsion)
:(interjection)
:class: UI1

:Related words: See also '''cinri''', '''selcni'''

:'''a'u ro jbopre cu stati prenu''' = ''Interesting, all Lojbanists are smart people.''
:'''a'u ma krinu''' = ''Hm, what is the reason?''
:'''.a'u cu'i do se zdani ka'ai lo nanla''' = ''It's none of my business that you live with a boy.''
:'''a'u nai panci fa lo kalci''' = ''Yuck, that smells like shit!''

'''ba'a'''
:'''ba'a''' - 'I expect', '''ba'acu'i''' - 'I experience', '''ba'anai''' - 'I remember'
:(evidential)
:class: UI2
:Explanation: ???'''ba'a''' describes knowledge not yet know, '''ba'acu'i''' - knowledge being acquired at the moment of speking, '''ba'anai''' describes already acquired knowledge. The events marked with these interjections may happen at any time, thus '''ba'a''' might be related to past events, which you simply don't have information about yet..

:Related words: See also '''bavykri''', '''lifri''', '''morji'''

:'''ba'a lo mi mamta ca zvati le zdani''' = ''I expect my mother to be at home now.''
:'''ba'a le mi pendo pu jinga''' = ''I expect my friend to have won.''
:'''ba'acu'i lo se klani be lo sovda cu lacri lo tcika lo nu lo jipci cu jai gau cfari''' = ''In my experience, the number of eggs depends on when a hen starts.''
:'''ba'anai do na nelci lo laldo prenu''' = ''As I remember, you don't like old people.''

'''ba'e'''
:puts an emphasis on the following construct

'''lo'ai'''
:To correct yourself say '''lo'ai''', then the incorrect construct, then '''sa'ai''', then the same but corrected construct, then '''le'ai'''.
:class: LOhAI
:Explanation: You may just start with '''sa'ai''' if it's obvious what is corrected. The word '''le'ai''' on its own indicates that an obvious mistake was made. '''le'ai''' '''dai''' indicates that the other partner made a mistake. '''le'ai''' '''pei''' asks whether the partner made a mistake. '''le'ai''' '''nai''' explicitly denies mistakes.

:erases one last Lojban word. non-Lojban text is treated as one word
:class: SI

:'''au mi citka lo kokso si perli''' = ''I'd like to eat a coconut, no, pear!''
'''si'a'''
:similarly - not similarly
:(discursive)
:class: UI3b
:Explanation: '''ji'a''' means 'additionally', '''si'a''' means 'similarly' implying that there is another salient difference..

:Related words: See also '''simsa''', '''panra'''

:'''mi si'a pu vitke le tcadu''' = ''I also visited the city (just in another year).''
:'''sa'u go'i ca lo drata nanca i mi nelci lo finpe si'anai''' = ''But i like fish.''
'''si'au'''
:It seems'
:(evidential)
:class: UI2

:'''si'au le fetsi cu xebni do''' = ''It seems, she hates you.''
:'''si'au le ctuca pu co'u pacna''' = ''It seems, the teacher was disappointed.''
'''si'e'''
:x1 (located) is an (n)th portion of mass x2 (located). The number (n) is to be put before '''si'e'''
:(from number to verb word denoting a portion)
:class: MOI

:'''lo stati cu kakne lo ka zukte lo zabna''' = ''Smart people can do nice things.''
:'''ku'i sy mo'asi'e lo se gugde''' = ''But they represent a too small fraction of citizens.''
'''si'o'''
:x1 is x2's concept described in the bridi that follows
:(from clause to selbri)
:class: NU

:'''mi nelci lo si'o xunre''' = ''I like the color red.''
'''si'u'''
:with the help of ...
:(preposition from '''sidju''')
:class: BAI
:Explanation: x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo sidju''' - 'who helps', preposition sumti corresponds to '''lo se sidju''' - 'the one being helped', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo te sidju''' - 'the situation in which one helps.

:'''le verba ca kakne lo ka cadzu vau si'u lo rirni''' = ''The child is able to walk now with the help of parents.''
'''si'unai'''
:oneself, without help
:(preposition from '''sidju''')
:class: BAI

:'''mi kakne lo ka punji si'unai''' = ''I can put it myself.''

:'''mi zifre lo ka zukte lo se nelci be mi''' = ''I am free to do what I like.''
'''zigzagi'''
:x1 (entity) is a line with the shape of a zigzag

:'''lo zigzagi''' = zigzag

:Related words: '''boxna''', '''linji'''

:'''lo pluta be lo cmana pu zigzagi''' = ''The route to the mountain zigzagged.''
'''zildukse'''
:x1 (entity) is in excess, is too much for x2 (property of x1) to take place (event)

:'''lo zildukse''' = excess

:Related words: '''bancu''', '''banzu''', '''ricfu''', '''zmadu'''

:'''lo nu mi tatpi cu zildukse lo nu mi sidju do''' = ''I'm too tired to help you.''
'''zinki'''
:x1 (entity) is a quantity of zinc

:'''lo zinki''' = zinc

:Related words: '''jinme'''

:'''lo cidja cu vasru lo zinki''' = ''The food contains zinc.''
'''zirpu'''
:x1 (entity) is purple

:'''lo zirpu''' = purple

:Related words: '''skari''', '''blabi''', '''xekri''', '''kandi''', '''carmi''', '''nukni''', '''blanu''', '''xunre'''

:'''lo taxfu cu zirpu''' = ''The dress is purple.''
'''zivle'''
:x1 (entity) invests resources x2 (entity) into x3 (entity, property of x1) expecting profit x4 (entity)

:'''lo zivle''' = investor
:'''lo se zivle''' = invested
:'''lo ve zivle''' = expected profit of an investment

:Related words: '''prali''', '''canja''', '''jbera''', '''dejni''', '''ponse'''

:'''ra pu zivle lo jdini lo ka sidju lo cnino sanga''' = ''He invested money in a new singer.''
:'''ai mi zivle lo nejni lo ka prami do vau lo nu do prami mi''' = ''I take a chance on loving you so that you will love me.''
'''zmadu'''
:x1 (entity) exceeds or is more than x2 (entity) in x3 (property of x1 and x2 with '''kau''') by amount x4 (entity)

:'''lo zmadu''' = more
:'''lo se zmadu''' = less

:Related words: '''mau''', '''mleca''', '''zenba''', '''jmina''', '''bancu''', '''dukse''', '''traji'''

:'''ra zmadu mi lo ka tilju vau lo ki'ogra be li pano''' = ''He weighs ten more kilograms than me.''
'''zmiku'''
:x1 (entity) is automatic in function x2 (property of x1)

:'''lo zmiku''' = robot, automatic
:'''lo se zmiku''' = function of a robot

:Related words: '''macnu'''

:'''lo vorme ci zmiku lo ka co'a kalri''' = ''The door opens automatically.''
'''zo'''
:quotes next single word only that must be Lojbanic
:(from a verb word to a noun that is a quote)
:class: ZO
:Explanation: To quote compound particles, compound verbs and phrases use '''lu''' ...'''li'u'''. To quote arbitrary sequences of words use '''lo'u''' ... '''le'u'''..

:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''

:'''zo gleki cmene mi''' = ''Gleki is my name.''
'''zo'e'''
:a noun unspecified or known from context
:(pronoun)
:class: KOhA7

:'''zo'e carvi''' = ''It's raining.''
:'''la eduard pu cusku zo'e ne le pa gerku''' = ''Eduard said something about the dog.''
'''zo'ei'''
:something about ...', 'something associated with ...'
:class: LAhE
:Explanation: Equivalent to '''zo'e''' '''pe'''.

:Related words: '''tu'a'''

:famyma'o: lu'u

:'''mi pu na djuno zo'ei le nabmi''' = ''I didn't know of the problem.''
'''zo'i'''
:on the same side as ...
:(preposition)
:class: FAhA4

:'''mi sanli bu'u lo klaji zo'i le muzga''' = ''I'm standing on the street on the same side as the museum.''
:'''mi zutse lo lalxu korbi zo'i le laldo cindu''' = ''I'm sitting by the river on the same side as the old oak.''
'''zo'o'''
:'''zo'o''' - 'Kidding...' (humorously), '''zo'ocu'i''' - without paying attention to seriousness or humor, '''zo'onai''' - 'seriously'
:(interjection modifier)
:class: UI5

:Related words: See also '''xajmi''', '''junri'''

:'''zo'opei''' = ''Are you kidding?''
:'''e'u zo'o renro la kevin lo vi kevna''' = ''Let's throw Kevin into this hole (kidding ...) I might be able to jump from the hill.''
:'''mi kakne lo ka plipe fi lo ve'i cmana vau zo'ocu'i i zo'onai do fanza''' = ''Seriously, you are annoying.''
'''zo'oi'''
:quotes next single word only that can be not Lojbanic. The quoted word is delimited by pauses (in speech) or whitespaces (in writing) from both sides. The quoted word can't have pauses inside if pronounced, nor dots when written
:(from a verb word to a noun that is a quote)
:class: ZOhOI

:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''

:'''zo'oi again se traduki fi lu za'ure'u li'u''' = ''again is translated as '''za'u re'u'''.''
'''zo'u'''
:separates topic and comment
:class: ZOhU

:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''

:'''lo danlu zo'u mi nelci lo mlatu''' = ''As for animals, I like cats.''
:'''vo da poi gerku vau re de poi prenu zo'u da batci de''' = ''There are four '''da''' (that are dogs) and there are two '''de''' (that are men) such that each dog ('''da''') bites the two men ('''de''').''
'''zoi'''
:quotes a text that can be not Lojbanic. The quotation is to be wrapped with pauses from both sides and with an additional Lojbanic word around them from both sides.
:(from a verb word to a noun that is a quote)
:class: ZOI
:Explanation: Usually the separating Lojbanic word is the first letter of the language in the quotation..

:Related words: '''zo'oi''', '''zoi''', '''la'o''', '''la'oi''', '''zo''', '''lu''' ... '''li'u''', '''lo'e''', '''lo'u''', '''me'oi'''

:'''lu coi ro do li'u se traduki fi zoi gy. Hello, everyone! .gy. noi glico''' = '''''coi ro do''' is translated to English as Hello, everyone!''
'''zu'''
:a long time ago
:(preposition)
:class: ZI

:Related words: '''zi''', '''za''', '''zu'''

:'''la alis pu cliva zu lo nanca be li pano''' = ''Alice left ten years ago (a long time).''
'''zu'a'''
:leftwards, to the left of ...
:(preposition)
:class: FAhA2

:'''ko catlu lo pa karce pe zu'a do''' = ''Look at a car to the left of you.''
'''zu'e'''
:via a free will; with a goal-seeking actor ...
:(preposition from '''zukte''')
:class: BAI
:Explanation: actor case tag. x1 of the clause corresponds to '''lo zukte''', the clause itself corresponds to '''lo se zukte'''.

:'''zu'enai je fa mi viska lo dinju''' = ''A building caught my eye.''
:'''zu'e je fa mi tirna lo zgike''' = ''I listened to the music.''
'''zu'i'''
:a sumti typical for this place
:(pronoun)
:class: KOhA7

:'''mi pu penmi zu'i bu'u zu'i''' = ''I met the usual people at the usual place.''

'''zu'u'''
:'''zu'u''' - 'on the one hand', '''zu'unai''' - 'on the other hand'
:(discursive)
:class: UI3

:Related words: See also '''karbi''', '''frica''', '''dukti'''

:'''zu'u le jufra cu satci lo ka se smuni''' = ''On the one hand, the sentence is exact in meaning.''
:'''zu'unai du'eva'e clani''' = ''On the other hand it is too long.''
'''zukte'''
:x1 (entity) takes action x2 (property of x1) for purpose x3 (property of x1)

:'''lo zukte''' = actor
:'''lo se zukte''' = taken action
:'''lo te zukte''' = purpose of action

:Related words: '''zu'e''', '''bapli''', '''gunka''', '''jalge''', '''krinu''', '''mukti''', '''rinka''', '''snuti''', '''gasnu''', '''fasnu''', '''minji''', '''prenu''', '''ciksi''', '''jibri''', '''pilno''', '''pluta''', '''tadji''', '''tutci'''

:'''i mi zukte lo me mi moi tu'a lo me mi moi''' = ''I'm doing my own work for myself.''
:'''xu do ca'o zukte lo cipra''' = ''Are you performing a test?''
:'''mi zukte lo ka darxi le nakni''' = ''I intentionally hit him.''
:'''mi ba zukte roda lonu do nelci mi''' = ''I would do everything so that you like me.''
'''zumri'''
:x1 (entity) is some corn or maize of species x2 (species)

:'''lo zumri''' = maize

:Related words: '''gurni'''

:'''mi sombo lo samcu je lo zumri''' = ''I plant yams and maize.''
'''zungi'''
:x1 (entity) feels guilty about x2 (event, property of x1)


:Related words: '''u'u''', '''cinmo''', '''xenru''', '''zekri'''

:'''mi zungi lo ka pu cusku lo jitfa''' = ''I feel guilty about having told a lie.''
'''zunle'''
:x1 (entity) is to the left of x2 (entity) in frame of reference x3 (entity)

:'''lo zunle''' = left (in direction)

:Related words: '''zu'a''', '''pritu''', '''mlana''', '''crane''', '''trixe''', '''farna'''

:'''lo dinju cu zunle lo rokci ti''' = ''The house is to the left of the rock if viewed from here.''
'''zunti'''
:x1 (entity) interferes with or disrupts x2 (entity) due to x3 (property of x1)

:'''lo se zunti''' = hindered, disrupted

:Related words: '''fanta''', '''dicra''', '''fliba''', '''fanza''', '''raktu''', '''klina''', '''bandu''', '''cfipu''', '''ganlo'''

:'''lo gerku cu zunti lo nu mi lumci lo kumfa vau lo ka plipe''' = ''The dog leaping hinders me from cleaning the room.''
'''zutse'''
:x1 (entity) sits on x2 (entity)


:Related words: '''stizu''', '''cpana''', '''vreta'''

:'''e'a do zutse lo stizu''' = ''You may sit down on the chair.''
'''zvati'''
:x1 (entity) is present at x2 (entity)
:Explanation: '''stuzi''' is for a stable/inherent location


:Related words: '''stuzi''', '''jbini''', '''nenri''', '''se''' '''vasru''', '''cpana''', '''diklo''', '''jibni''', '''cabna''', '''lamji''', '''tcini''', '''xabju''', '''jmive''', '''jundi''', '''vitke'''

:'''lo sivni kumfa cu zvati ma''' = ''Where is the toilet?''
:'''mi pu zvati lo nu penmi''' = ''I was at the meeting.''
'''zy'''
:letter 'Z'
:(pronoun: letter)
:class: BY2
